title: Maxim and Array
statementMd:
Recently Maxim has found an array of $*n*$ integers, needed by no one. He immediately come up with idea of changing it: he invented positive integer $*x*$ and decided to add or subtract it from arbitrary array elements. Formally, by applying single operation Maxim chooses integer $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) and replaces the $*i*$-th element of array $*a*_{*i*}$ either with $*a*_{*i*} + *x*$ or with $*a*_{*i*} - *x*$. Please note that the operation may be applied more than once to the same position.

Maxim is a curious minimalis, thus he wants to know what is the minimum value that the product of all array elements (i.e. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f9309f35d7faa3a510387f08ee16afbd2ef1d2a.png)) can reach, if Maxim would apply no more than $*k*$ operations to it. Please help him in that.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*, *k*$ and $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 200 000, 1 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of elements in the array, the maximum number of operations and the number invented by Maxim, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a8b1c66df023fb7075ec9dba75e73a53f173334.png)) — the elements of the array found by Maxim.

## Output

Print $*n*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ in the only line — the array elements after applying no more than $*k*$ operations to the array. In particular, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25a4bad1de460e01b26a65b4e7c0cc0680b347dd.png) should stay true for every $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$, but the product of all array elements should be **minimum possible**.

If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
最近，Maxim 找到了一个无人需要的包含 $*n*$ 个整数的数组。他立刻想出了修改它的主意：他发明了一个正整数 $*x*$，并决定将其加到或减去任意数组元素上。形式化地说，在一次操作中，Maxim 选择一个整数 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$），并将数组的第 $*i*$ 个元素 $*a*_{*i*}$ 替换为 $*a*_{*i*} + *x*$ 或 $*a*_{*i*} - *x*$。请注意，同一个位置可以被操作多次。

Maxim 是一个好奇的极简主义者，因此他想知道：如果 Maxim 对数组执行不超过 $*k*$ 次操作，所有数组元素的乘积（即 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f9309f35d7faa3a510387f08ee16afbd2ef1d2a.png)）能够达到的最小值是多少？请帮助他解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ 和 $*x*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 200 000$，$1 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$）——数组中元素的数量、最多允许的操作次数以及 Maxim 发明的数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a8b1c66df023fb7075ec9dba75e73a53f173334.png)）——Maxim 找到的数组中的元素。

## 输出格式

在唯一一行中输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$——对数组执行不超过 $*k*$ 次操作后的数组元素。特别地，对于每个 $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$，都应满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25a4bad1de460e01b26a65b4e7c0cc0680b347dd.png)，并且所有数组元素的乘积应当是**可能的最小值**。

如果有多个答案，输出其中任意一个即可。
